description: FastAPI deprecated @app.on_event lifecycle hooks in favor of lifespan context manager
fix_hint: Replace @app.on_event('startup') with async lifespan context manager

description: requests.get() without timeout parameter can hang indefinitely
fix_hint: Add timeout=10 parameter to all requests calls
Move initialization logic to app factory or use app.before_request with a flag

description: SQLAlchemy 2.0 removed autocommit mode from Session
fix_hint: Remove autocommit=True and use explicit session.commit()

description: OpenAI SDK v1.0 replaced openai.ChatCompletion with client.chat.completions
Node.js Buffer() constructor is deprecated due to security issues
React componentWillMount is deprecated since React 16.3, removed in React 19
React componentWillReceiveProps is deprecated, removed in React 19
fix_hint: Use static getDerivedStateFromProps or useEffect with dependency array

description: PyYAML yaml.load() without Loader is unsafe and deprecated
urllib3 v2.0 changed HTTPResponse API significantly
fix_hint: Update to urllib3 v2.x compatible API calls

description: Flask extensions import path flask.ext.* removed in Flask 1.0
fix_hint: Import directly from the extension package, e.g. flask_sqlalchemy

description: Django url() with regex is deprecated in Django 4.0, use path() or re_path()
fix_hint: Replace url(r'^pattern$', view) with path('pattern/', view) or re_path()

description: pkg_resources is deprecated in favor of importlib.resources and importlib.metadata
fix_hint: Use importlib.resources for resource access, importlib.metadata for package info

description: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated in Python 3.12 in favor of timezone-aware datetimes
asyncio.get_event_loop() deprecated in Python 3.10+ when no running loop
fix_hint: Use asyncio.new_event_loop() or asyncio.run() at top level

description: distutils removed in Python 3.12, replaced by setuptools
fix_hint: Replace distutils imports with setuptools equivalents

description: imp module deprecated since Python 3.4, removed in 3.12
cgi module deprecated in Python 3.11, removed in 3.13
fix_hint: Use email.message module for header parsing
